featured_reviews.name: swapnil jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined the weekend TTC batch, and it has been one of the most beautiful experiences of my yoga journey. The studio is extremely peaceful, spacious, and well-equipped with all the props you can imagine. The staff maintains the place with so much cleanliness and care, and the overall environment instantly makes you feel grounded and makes you genuinely want to practice.
The batch size is small, which means you receive proper attention and guidance in every class. Neha Ma’am teaches with so much warmth and clarity. She focuses not just on physical practice, but also on the mental, emotional, and spiritual aspects of yoga. The course is very well-structured and covers everything: asanas, alignment, anatomy, philosophy, and the yogic lifestyle. There’s a perfect balance of theory and practice, which really deepens the understanding of yoga beyond the mat.
We also got opportunities to lead classes gradually, and the feedback we received helped us understand our strengths and areas to work on. After finishing the main course, Neha Ma’am spent extra time helping us revise for the exam, clear our doubts, and feel confident about teaching, understanding health conditions, and guiding students safely. I never felt rushed, she is incredibly supportive, patient, and friendly.
A big thank you to Balu bhai and the entire staff for creating such a welcoming atmosphere. On days when we sat for long hours, Balu bhai would bring tea for everyone, honestly the best tea ever.
I’m truly grateful for this experience. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a nice, in-depth, and heart-centered TTC.
